implementability_check.multiple_mains: Both test programs declare their own Main; compiling them together is possible only with an explicit /main, which does not solve the fixture accessibility above.
implementability_check.conclusion: The bridge needs its own minimal scene (engine global + World50 + a world view with floor/regions + a move request context). It is not a merge of the two existing fixtures.
